card.name: Table titles and section divider lines
card.fires_on: The first word or dash line right after a section heading or table title, where the body or table content begins. Seen after headings like WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS and after labels like 'Table 1: ...'.

modes.label: Dash lines after headings
modes.description: A row of dashes following an all-caps section heading in a label highlights block.

modes.label: Start of table text
modes.description: The first word or letter of text right after a table title, often split mid-word.
